title: CodeHID: Learning an Addressable Hierarchical Code Index for Generative Code Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2608.24089v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Code retrieval models have predominantly relied on a flat matching paradigm that treats code snippets as independent candidates, making them less capable of distinguishing similar code candidates. Generative retrieval offers a solution by constructing a learnable index over the code corpus, guiding the retriever to better understand how code candidates are semantically organized and addressed. However, naively applying generative retrieval in the code retrieval task may result in operating over an identifier space whose prefixes do not correspond to meaningful code-semantic regions. In this paper, we propose CodeHID, a generative code retrieval framework that reformulates the code retrieval task from flat candidate matching to coarse-to-fine semantic address generation. translated_title: CodeHID：学习可寻址的分层代码索引用于生成式代码检索
translated_abstract: 代码检索模型主要依赖一种平面匹配范式，将代码片段视为独立候选，这使得它们难以区分相似的代码候选。生成式检索通过构建代码库上的可学习索引提供了一种解决方案，引导检索器更好地理解代码候选的语义组织和寻址方式。然而，在代码检索任务中直接应用生成式检索可能面临标识符空间的操作问题，其前缀不对应于有意义的代码语义区域。在本文中，我们提出了CodeHID，一种生成式代码检索框架，将代码检索任务从平面候选匹配重构为从粗到细的语义地址生成。CodeHID依赖于两个核心组件。首先，伪邻居引导的DocID学习通过应用多级残差量化构建全局静态的分层索引。
tldr: CodeHID通过构建分层的可寻址代码索引，将代码检索从平面匹配转变为从粗到细的语义地址生成，从而提升对相似代码候选的区分能力。
en_tdlr: CodeHID transforms code retrieval from flat matching to coarse-to-fine semantic address generation by building a hierarchical addressable code index, improving discrimination among similar code candidates.
